title: 第23章 富贵人间第24章 红裙女子
lines: 看着齐斌那张贪婪的嘴脸，江来淡淡道：“齐总，你知道我平生最痛恨的是什么吗？”
“什么？”
“毒品！”江来冷声道：“你以后在我面前最好注意点，不然的话，别怪我不客气。”
听到这话，齐斌不自觉的一颤，战战兢兢道：“是，我……我明白了。”
“我问你，岳坤对外销售的药丸都是从哪来的？”
“这种机密的事情我哪清楚。”
“你不是跟岳坤搭上线了吗？那你继续想办法获取他的信任，然后从他手里拿货，最好能弄清楚他的毒品来源。只要这件事情办成，我立刻放了你。”
齐斌苦笑道：“江先生，你这不是为难我吗？万一被岳坤发现，我这条命铁定完蛋。”
“你要是不答应，我现在就杀了你，所以你最好考虑清楚，是马上死，还是舍命为自己搏一把。”顿了顿，江来话锋一转道：“你放心，我和柳寞会从旁协助你，我们的本事你应该都见识过，如果真有危险，我们会确保你的安全。”
“真的？”齐斌似乎松了口气，“只要江先生跟柳先生肯罩着我，我可以尝试一下。”
“很好！”江来点点头道：“我先把丑话说在前面，如果你敢出卖我，或者做出任何威胁整个行动的举动，不仅是你，还包括你的家人，我一个都不会放过，听明白没有？”
齐斌唯唯诺诺的应道：“明白。”
从房间出来，江来和柳寞来到角落，一人点燃一支香烟。随着香烟慢慢烧尽，江来缓缓道：“索兰特来QZ市了，我想跟他聊聊。”
“知道了，我会想办法找他出来。”
江来微微一笑，他最喜欢跟柳寞说话，不用费劲，对方就能领会他的意思。他拍拍对方的肩膀，道：“我知道你累，但没办法，现在人手有限，只能辛苦你一下，我会尽快找人替你分担。”
离开小破屋，江来看了看时间，已经下午两点多钟了。当下，他叫了辆出租车，径直返回了华庭御府的住处。
傍晚时分，整个QZ市灯火通明，宽敞的街道上车流不息。在东南城区一条名为福岚街的街道两旁，灯红酒绿，霓光绚烂，劲爆的音乐响彻整条街区。一些穿着清凉的时尚男女三五成群，在各个酒吧间来回穿梭，还有打扮妖冶性感的女人站在路边，替自家酒吧招揽着客人。
此时，一辆计程车缓缓驶来，停靠在路边，随着车门打开，一名身材修长的青年走下来，看着周围热闹的环境，嘴角微微扬起，露出一丝邪魅的笑容。
“不愧是QZ市最繁华的酒吧一条街，果然是应有尽有。”江来欣赏着街边袒胸露背的美女，暗暗点头，然后举步往一家名为‘富贵人间’的夜总会走去。
富贵人间是整条街面积最大的夜总会，生意非常火爆，门口人来人往，络绎不绝，两名身材彪悍，穿着紧身背心的光头男站在左右，抱着双臂，犹如两尊门神，满脸冷酷。
跟随着人流，江来走进夜总会，只见里面人满为患，所有桌台都坐满了客人。在夜总会的中央，是一个旋转的舞台，几名风姿妖娆的美女露着小蛮腰，扭动着婀娜的身姿，表演的尺度非常大，不时惹来台下观众的狼嚎声。
观察了几眼后，江来对整个夜总会的格局有了初步的了解，一共有上中下三层，一楼是大厅，二楼是KTV包厢，三楼是客房，提供一些不可描述的特殊服务。
在大厅东面靠墙的位置，有一个环形的吧台，客人比较少。江来找了个视野较好的座位，点了一杯威士忌，小口小口的品着，目光却游走在周围客人的身上。
不多时，一名身穿西装，戴着一副金边眼镜的清瘦男子出现在他的视线中。男子刚从门口进来，身后跟着几名体型彪悍的手下。一路走来，不时有客人离座上前跟他打招呼。
“就是他了！”江来微眯着眼，将杯中的威士忌一饮而尽，然后起身准备过去。
这时，一阵干呕声突然从他的旁边传来，转头看去，只见吧台不远处坐着一名长发女子，一身性感的露背红裙，身姿曼妙，曲线窈窕，丰满的双峰露出半抹春光，虽然秀发遮脸，但在她转身的一瞬间，却能隐约看到那精美的五官和清秀绝伦的面部轮廓。
在红裙女子的身前，摆放着七八个空酒杯，估计是不胜酒量的缘故，她干呕了几声，忙不迭的离开座位，一路跌跌撞撞往卫生间方向跑去。
很不巧的是，那名眼镜男正好从旁边经过，红裙女子一个不留神，直接撞了满怀。
尾随在后面的几名彪悍男子见状，立刻一拥而上，想要将女子拉扯开。但是，眼镜男却制止了他们的举动，双手搀扶着红裙女子，在她面前低语了几句。也不知道二人说了什么，眼镜男搂着红裙女子纤细的柳腰，径直往电梯间走去。
看着电梯的数字停在三楼，江来不由笑了笑，真是天助我也！本来他还在想怎么接近对方，既然对方带着女人去了三楼，必定会开房独处，这样一来，他就不用费心去解决那些手下，以免引起太大的动静。
在大厅的旁边，有一条无人看守的安全通道，江来沿着楼梯来到三楼，正准备推开安全门进去，结果却发现安全门从里面反锁住了。
他皱了皱眉，看了眼四周的环境，发现旁边有一扇玻璃窗，在玻璃窗外有一根管道，固定在墙壁上，直通整个楼层。见状，他立刻翻身穿过窗户，然后踩着管道，慢慢的往前移动。
透过窗户，江来搜查着所有房间，想要找出眼镜男的位置。可是，有些客房的窗户被拉上了窗帘，只能通过里面的声音来辨别是否有自己找寻的目标，一来二去，自然耽误了不少时间。
片刻过去，当他从一扇窗户底部经过时，突然听到一个熟悉的声音传入耳中。
“咦？这家伙居然也在。”
content_en:
Looking at Qi Bin's greedy face, Jiang Lai said lightly: "Mr. Qi, do you know what I hate most in my life?"
"What?"
"Drugs!" Jiang Lai said coldly: "You'd better be careful in front of me in the future, otherwise, don't blame me for being rude."
Hearing this, Qi Bin trembled unconsciously and said tremblingly: "Yes, I...I understand."
"Let me ask you, where do the pills Yue Kun sells come from?"
"I don't know anything about such confidential matters."
"Didn't you get in touch with Yue Kun? Then you continue to think of ways to gain his trust, and then get the goods from him. It's best to figure out the source of his drugs. As long as this thing is done, I will let you go immediately."
Qi Bin smiled bitterly and said, "Mr. Jiang, aren't you making things difficult for me? If Yue Kun finds out, my life will definitely be over."
"If you don't agree, I will kill you now, so you'd better think carefully about whether to die immediately or risk your life to fight for yourself." After a pause, Jiang Lai changed the subject and said: "Don't worry, Liu Mo and I will assist you. You should have seen our skills. If there is really danger, we will ensure your safety."
"Really?" Qi Bin seemed relieved, "As long as Mr. Jiang and Mr. Liu are willing to protect me, I can give it a try."
"Very good!" Jiang Lai nodded and said, "I'll put the ugly words first. If you dare to betray me, or make any move that threatens the entire operation, not only you, but also your family, I won't let anyone go. Do you understand?"
Qi Bin responded solemnly: "Understood."
After coming out of the room, Jiang Lai and Liu Mo came to the corner and each lit a cigarette. As the cigarette slowly burned out, Jiang Lai said slowly: "Solant has come to QZ City. I want to talk to him."
"I know, I will find a way to find him out."
Jiang Lai smiled slightly. He liked talking to Liu Mo the most. The other party could understand what he meant without any effort. He patted the other party's shoulder and said: "I know you are tired, but there is nothing I can do. The manpower is limited now, so I can only work hard for you. I will find someone to share the burden for you as soon as possible."
After leaving the small shabby house, Jiang looked at the time. It was already past two o'clock in the afternoon. At that moment, he called a taxi and went straight back to the residence of Huating Yufu.
In the evening, the entire QZ city is brightly lit, and there is a constant flow of traffic on the spacious streets. On both sides of a street called Fulan Street in the southeastern city, there are bright lights, bright lights, and loud music resounding throughout the block. Some fashionable men and women in cool clothes were in groups, shuttling back and forth between bars. There were also women dressed in coquettish and sexy clothes standing on the roadside, soliciting customers for their own bars.
At this time, a taxi slowly drove up and parked on the side of the road. As the door opened, a slender young man stepped out and looked at the lively environment around him. The corners of his mouth were raised slightly, revealing a sinister smile.
"It is indeed the most prosperous bar street in QZ City. It really has everything you need." Jiang Lai admired the topless beauties on the street, nodded secretly, and then walked towards a nightclub called 'Rich World'.
The Rich World is the largest nightclub in the entire street. Business is very popular. There is an endless stream of people coming and going at the door. Two bald men with strong builds and tight vests stand on the left and right, arms folded, like two door gods, with cold faces.
Following the flow of people, Jiang Lai walked into the nightclub and saw that it was crowded, and all the tables were filled with guests. In the center of the nightclub, there was a revolving stage, with several enchanting beauties baring their waists and twisting their graceful figures. The scale of their performances was very large, and the audience howled from time to time.
After a few observations, Jiang Lai had a preliminary understanding of the layout of the entire nightclub. There were three floors, upper, middle and lower. The first floor was the lobby, the second floor was the KTV box, and the third floor was the guest rooms, which provided some indescribable special services.
There is a circular bar on the east wall of the hall with relatively few customers. Jiang came to find a seat with a better view, ordered a glass of whiskey, and sipped it in small sips while his eyes wandered around the guests.
Not long after, a thin man wearing a suit and a pair of gold-rimmed glasses appeared in his sight. The man just came in from the door, followed by several tough men. Along the way, guests would leave their seats and come up to greet him from time to time.
"That's him!" Jiang Lai squinted his eyes slightly, drank all the whiskey in the glass, then stood up and prepared to go over.
"Ugh!"
At this time, a sound of retching suddenly came from beside him. He turned around and saw a long-haired woman sitting not far from the bar. She was wearing a sexy backless red dress. She had a graceful figure and slim curves. Her plump breasts were half exposed. Although her hair covered her face, the moment she turned around, she could vaguely see her exquisite facial features and delicate facial contours.
There were seven or eight empty wine glasses placed in front of the woman in the red dress. It was probably because she was too drunk. She retched a few times, hurriedly left her seat, and stumbled towards the bathroom.
Unfortunately, the man with glasses happened to be passing by, and the woman in the red dress accidentally bumped into him.
When the several tough men following behind saw this, they immediately swarmed up and tried to pull the woman away. However, the man with glasses stopped their actions, supported the woman in the red skirt with both hands, and whispered a few words in front of her. I don’t know what the two of them said. The man with glasses put his arm around the slender waist of the woman in red dress and walked straight to the elevator.
Seeing the number on the elevator stopping at the third floor, Jiang Lai couldn't help but smile. God is helping me! Originally, he was still thinking about how to get close to the other party. Since the other party took the woman to the third floor, he would definitely open a room to be alone. In this way, he would not have to worry about dealing with those subordinates to avoid causing too much noise.
Next to the hall, there was an unguarded safety passage. Jiang Lai walked along the stairs to the third floor. He was about to push the safety door open and go in, but found that the safety door was locked from the inside.
He frowned, looked at his surroundings, and found a glass window next to him. There was a pipe outside the glass window, fixed on the wall, and leading directly to the entire floor. Seeing this, he immediately turned over and passed through the window, then stepped on the pipe and moved forward slowly.
Through the window, Jiang Lai searched all the rooms, trying to find the location of the man with glasses. However, the curtains were drawn on the windows of some guest rooms, and you could only tell whether there was the target you were looking for through the sounds inside. Going back and forth naturally wasted a lot of time.
A moment later, as he passed by the bottom of a window, he suddenly heard a familiar voice reaching his ears.
"Huh? This guy is actually here."
title_en: Chapter 23 The Rich World Chapter 24 The Woman in Red Dress
